senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Jephthah, the Judge.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25b:2">R. Hash. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>י׳ בדורו כשמואל וכ׳</he> the authority of a J. in his days must be respected as that of a Samuel in his; Tosef. ib. II (I), 3 <he>בית דינו של י׳</he>.
